pages.title: Read Aloud
pages.text: While wearing Mage equipment, successfully use two different Magic Books: one combat and one support.

pages.title: Read Aloud
pages.text: Soul Gems and blood support further book experiments without granting a finished rare caster.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Ice, tornado, mark, beam, spikes, black hole and Naginata books have distinct actions; Brace and Heal Ring support allies. Naginata has a native precision modifier. Mage gear affects damage/cooldowns; use installed values, not guessed percentages.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Wear Mage armor and use Magic Books. Native set text reduces incoming damage and Magic Book cooldown; exact percentages are substitution parameters, not fixed research values.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Choose Ice Shard, Ice Tornado, Fire Mark, Brace, Heal Ring, Stone Spikes, Magic Ray, Black Hole or Naginata Book. Books respectively provide piercing frost, tornado, mark, fire projectile, healing circle, ground spikes, beam, enemy pull and falling weapons; Naginata has a precision modifier key.
